column1: # Standard Spoken Tamil word list used for keyboard suggestions.
# One word per line, optionally followed by a TAB (or spaces) and a frequency:
# - Frequency is a whole number >= 0; higher means more common and ranks first.
# - Words may contain letters only (no spaces, digits or punctuation).
# - Type words exactly as they should be inserted, including Shift / long-press letters.
#   Lookup ignores Shift and long-press, so typing the same keys without them still finds the word.
# - Each word may appear only once.
# - Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Run `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` after editing; DictionaryAssetTest reports any malformed line.
# While this file has no words, the suggestion bar stays hidden.
